title: Non-Covered Amount Size Bands, Hospital Account (Encounter Billing)
content:
Riverbend grades the non-covered amount of an insured Hospital Account (Encounter Billing) account (the total of the account's non-covered-service liability postings) into three size bands, and the band adds percentage points to the non-covered discount percent.

| Non-covered amount | Percentage points added to the non-covered discount percent |
|---|---|
| at least 1000.00 | 10 |
| at least 250.00 but below 1000.00 | 5 |
| below 250.00 | none |

**Clause.** A non-covered amount of at least 1000.00 USD adds 10 percentage points to the non-covered discount percent; a non-covered amount of at least 250.00 but below 1000.00 adds 5 percentage points; a non-covered amount below 250.00 adds none.

## Band edges (hypothetical amounts)

| Non-covered amount | Band | Points |
|---|---|---|
| 1000.00 | top band | 10 |
| 999.99 | middle band | 5 |
| 250.00 | middle band | 5 |
| 249.99 | lowest band | none |

The band is read from the total of all non-covered-service liability postings on the account, not from any single posting: postings of 600.00 and 450.00 total 1050.00 and fall in the top band.
